title: OpenAI publishes expanded report on AI use in its own research and calls for industry-wide RSI measurement norms
content:
X author: @OpenAI

OpenAI released new data showing exponential growth in researchers' AI use, longer agent-completed tasks, and faster-growing human effort on safety/alignment. The report urges AI labs to publicly track and report recursive self-improvement indicators to inform governance.
